90 degrees

90 Μοίρες means 90 degrees, and that is what the blackboard inside says. A small kafeneio in the centre of Nicosia, with tables outside on Onasagorou and the name in dark letters above the door.

What guests say

Three of 45 Google reviews, 42 of them with five stars.

“This wonderful place confirms my suspicion that you need to get onto side streets and back streets for the best food. What a find 90 Moires was! Authentic, super food and outstanding service. was drawn in by the charm of the decor and streetscape, and I was not put off at all by a menu that communicated a fairly limited range in pictures, to help visitors like me. Especially since the pictures were mostly of grilled meat, chips (fries, for US readers), and salad. I had a grilled pork chop with both aforementioned sides, and a fresh orange juice. It was sublime. The very best of Cypriot cooking, with fresh ingredients and access to unlimited parsley. I saw only one person working, who seemed to do everything. He was the personification of excellent service. I will definitely be coming back here.”

Google review
“Lovely. Cheap and friendly and relaxing. Great service. Beer went down very easily and lunch platter was delicious”
